div.head: Af 38
div.ab: XXXV. Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdermen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ond wite, swa hit ryht sy, ⁊ beforan ðam CXX scll' ðam ealdermen to wite.
XXXV. Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdormen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ⁊ wite, swa hit ryht sie, ⁊ beforan þam CXX scill. ðam ealdormen to wite.
Si quis coram aldermanno regis in placito pugnet, emendet weram et witam, sicut rectum sit, et super hoc CXX sol. ad witam.
{XXXV} Gif mon beforan cyninges ealdormen on gemote gefeohte, bete wer ⁊ wite, swa hit ryht sie, ⁊ beforan þam CXX scill ðam ealdormen to wite.

If someone fights in the assembly in the presence of the king’s ealdorman, let him compensate with wer [of the person he injured] and fine, according to the law, and furthermore let him pay 120 shillings to the ealdorman as fine.

If anyone fights at a meeting in the presence of an ealdorman of the king, he shall pay as compensation [such] wergeld and fine as is due, but previous to this [he shall pay] a fine of 120 shillings to the ealdorman.
If anyone fights in a meeting in the presence of the king’s ealdorman, he is to pay wergild and fine, as it is the law, and before that, 120 shillings to the ealdorman as a fine.

Wenn jemand vor des Königs Ealdorman in der [Gerichts]versammlung ficht, büsse er [des Getroffenen] Wergeld [an die Gegenpartei] und Strafsumme, wie es [je nach der That] sich gebührt, und [noch] vor diesem [Allen] 120 Schill. dem Ealdorman zur Strafe.

If someone fights before the king’s ealdorman in the [judicial] assembly, let him pay [the struck man’s] wergeld [to the opposing party] and the fine, as is fitting [according to the deed], and [still] before [all] this 120 shillings to the ealdorman as a fine.
